low.note: Three two-page full rereads per event replace a tail call: +1 extra each; two tail/status calls normally, three calls at a two-page reread. Nominal 8820; with extra pages 8883. Assumption, not observed page size.

expected.note: 21000 shared live-window minutes is a calendar assumption, not sum of per-game minutes. 20% extra pages amortizes periodic full rereads; stagger and rate-limit extra requests. 11 is a planning concurrency, not a verified schedule maximum.

stressed.note: Retained outer ceiling: 10 pages plus metadata per game, doubled for bounded retry allowance; overcounts shared games status. 16 simultaneous games is theoretical/unreachable in the actual calendar, not realistic concurrency. Fail closed beyond page cap. Not the cursor-tail operating model.
